title: Not every light comes from God.
paragraphs: Not every light comes from God.
The Bible gives a warning many people ignore.

“Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.”
— 2 Corinthians 11:14

Not every spiritual voice is truth.
Not every miracle is from heaven.
Not every teacher who speaks about God is sent by Him.

Deception rarely looks evil.
It usually looks beautiful, inspiring, and convincing.
In the last days, Jesus warned that many would be misled. The question is not whether light appears — the question is where the light comes from.
The safest place to test every message is Scripture.
Would you recognize a false light if you saw one?

The most dangerous deception is the one that looks holy.
What are some ways believers can test whether a teaching truly comes from God?
